## Natural history notes

A medium-sized songbird characterized by its gray-brown upperparts, warm orange breast, white eye ring, and streaked throat. In Florida, it is mostly a winter visitor found in lawns, parks, wooded neighborhoods, hammocks, forest edges, fields, and areas with fruiting trees or shrubs. It feeds on insects, earthworms, and other small invertebrates, as well as berries and small fruits, often foraging on the ground or gathering in loose flocks during the nonbreeding season.
